uncertainty_note: The flow description does not explicitly state whether records are directly tied to named individuals, so attribution may rely on identifiers or re-identification from the dataset.

title: Cloud-hosted transfer and replication increase observability of sensitive communications
description: Sending analytics data, models, and the full health and location dataset to a third-party cloud provider creates an observable communication and storage event. The provider, and potentially parties monitoring replication or hosting operations, may detect that sensitive health-related processing and data hosting are taking place.
uncertainty_note: This is grounded in the existence of the transfer and third-party hosting; the description does not specify network protections or who can observe the communication.

title: Full dataset is disclosed to an additional predetermined external party
description: The flow makes analytics data, models, and the full health and location dataset accessible to a third-party cloud hosting provider. This expands exposure of highly sensitive personal data to an external party known at design time, which may be more parties than functionally necessary depending on hosting needs and architecture choices.

title: Replication to cloud provider propagates sensitive data beyond the originating service
description: The full health and location dataset is hosted and replicated at the cloud provider, propagating sensitive personal data outside the analytics service boundary. Such propagation increases disclosure risk and may be unnecessary if only a reduced or transformed subset is needed for hosting or analytics operations.

title: Sensitive health and location data types are shared with the cloud provider
description: This flow includes highly sensitive categories of personal data: health data and location data. Sharing the full dataset with the cloud provider may exceed what is strictly necessary for the hosting purpose, especially if less sensitive representations, aggregation, or encryption-separated storage could suffice.
uncertainty_note: The description confirms full health and location data are shared, but does not specify whether this full sensitivity is strictly required for the intended hosting arrangement.

title: Data subjects may be unaware that their full health and location dataset is hosted and replicated by a third party
description: Because the flow sends the full health and location dataset to a third-party cloud hosting provider for hosting and replication, data subjects may not be aware that their sensitive data is stored and duplicated outside the primary analytics service.
uncertainty_note: The flow description does not state whether notices or transparency mechanisms exist, so unawareness is plausible but not certain.

title: Third-party replication can hinder erasure or rectification across hosted copies
description: Once the full health and location dataset is hosted and replicated at the cloud provider, data subjects may have reduced practical control over correcting or deleting their data across all copies and replicas, especially if replication and backup processes are opaque or distributed.
uncertainty_note: The description mentions hosting and replication but does not specify retention, deletion, or synchronization controls.

title: Sharing the full health and location dataset with the cloud provider may violate data minimization
description: The flow explicitly transfers the full health and location dataset, along with analytics data and models, to a third-party cloud provider. If the provider does not need the complete raw dataset or full granularity for the hosting purpose, this may constitute processing more personal data than necessary.

title: Replicated cloud hosting may create storage-limitation compliance risk
description: Hosting and replication at the cloud provider can result in multiple persistent copies of sensitive health and location data being retained longer than necessary, creating a risk of violating storage limitation obligations.
uncertainty_note: The flow description confirms replication but does not specify retention periods or deletion controls.

title: Third-party hosting of full health and location data may raise lawfulness concerns
description: Transferring and replicating the full health and location dataset at a third-party cloud provider may require a clear lawful basis and appropriate safeguards due to the sensitivity of health and location data. If such safeguards or legal basis are inadequate, the processing may be unlawful.
uncertainty_note: The flow description alone does not establish whether an adequate lawful basis, processor arrangement, or safeguards are in place.
